# Memory Bank Brief

## Project Foundation
Hotshot Logistics: Cloud-native platform modernizing hotshot delivery operations through automated, real-time technology.

## Core Problem Statement
Traditional hotshot operations use manual processes, phone calls, and paper documentation, causing:
- Inefficient job assignment and dispatching
- Limited real-time visibility
- Poor communication gaps
- Manual tracking and reporting
- Scalability limitations

## Solution Overview
Full-stack platform with three integrated components:

### 1. Admin Dashboard (Next.js/React)
- Job creation, assignment, tracking
- Driver performance monitoring
- Customer relationship management
- Real-time dashboards and analytics
- Financial reporting and invoicing

### 2. Driver Mobile App (React Native/Expo)
- Job acceptance and management
- Real-time GPS tracking
- Proof of delivery capture
- In-app communication
- Earnings tracking

### 3. Backend API (.NET 8)
- RESTful APIs for all operations
- Real-time SignalR communication
- Native ADO.NET data access
- External service integrations
- Scalable cloud infrastructure

## Key Business Objectives
- Operational excellence: Streamline assignment, tracking, completion
- Real-time visibility: Live tracking and status updates
- Scalable growth: Support expansion without proportional costs
- Customer satisfaction: Transparency and communication
- Financial management: Automated billing and processing

## Success Metrics
- 75% reduction in job assignment time
- 99% real-time tracking accuracy
- 25% increase in driver utilization
- 50% fewer customer service inquiries
- 90% faster invoice processing
- 10x growth capability

## Target Users
- **Logistics Managers**: Operations oversight and management
- **Drivers**: Job execution and communication
- **Customers**: Delivery tracking and updates
- **Business Owners**: Analytics and financial management

## When to Apply
Apply when understanding project scope, requirements, or business context.
